summary: Added docshelf/access.py (Rules plus role, suspended, is_admin, acting_for, can_read/write/share/delete) and rewired listing, show, edit, share, delete and audit to it, each with a module-level RULES; store.py, render.py and errors.py are untouched. The 32 tests pass (including the new tests/test_access.py), and a 14,400-command random differential run against the original package (messy roles, blank teams, boundary minutes and days, wildcard grants, delegations) matched byte for byte in output, exit status and workspace files. The inconsistencies between the old copies (until-minute handling, suspension day, role case, blank teams, wildcard grants, delegate powers) are kept as per-command rules, not fixed.
